source: NHL official api-web.nhle.com public game-log + schedule, originally retrieved November 2026
source_cohort_rule: ALL OFFICIAL PLAYED SKATERS, in ALL regular-season games on first day 2023-24; freeze IDs before SOG target evaluation from November 1
roster_proxy: previous confirmed played-team game within 21 calendar days; generated for scheduled games independent of target current play status
availability_proxy: previous official game scheduled start+8 hours before target scheduled start minus 60 minutes, plus prior local game date
inference: exploratory date-cluster bootstrap only; no winner confirmatory claim
expected_limitations: Six 2023 opening-day teams; cohort excludes later debutants and is not full-league
Official original 2023-26 pregame snapshot timestamps do not exist
Historical played-team is inferred from prior appearances; transfers and late injuries not independently verifiable
